def transform(grid):
    bg = grid[0][0]
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    # Initialize output grid as a copy of input
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            if grid[r][c] != bg:
                v = grid[r][c]
                # Expand to the right
                for k in range(c + 1, cols):
                    if (k - c) % 2 == 1:
                        out[r][k] = 5
                    else:
                        out[r][k] = v
    return out
